stories.title: La rabieta más grande de Cristiano: abandona la concentración de Portugal

en.title: Cristiano's biggest tantrum: leaves Portugal concentration
en.summary: Portuguese striker Cristiano Ronaldo abandoned Portugal's team concentration in Copenhagen hours before a match against Denmark, following through on earlier statements about leaving if the coach did not count on him.

stories.title: Rusia amenaza con ataques nucleares a la UE si bloquea el enclave de Kaliningrado

en.title: Russia threatens nuclear attacks on EU if it blocks Kaliningrad enclave
en.summary: Russia issued a diplomatic warning that it would consider using nuclear weapons if NATO attempts to isolate its Baltic territory of Kaliningrad, also criticizing Brussels for irresponsible behavior.

stories.title: Un piloto apuñala a otro en pleno vuelo y pone al borde del desastre a un avión con destino a Israel

en.title: A pilot stabs another mid-flight and brings a plane heading to Israel to the brink of disaster
en.summary: A pilot stabbed a colleague during a flight from Dubai, and passengers and crew members subdued the attacker. Israel's defense minister described it as an attempted jihadist attack aimed at crashing the aircraft.

stories.title: Israel investiga como ataque terrorista el incidente del vuelo de Flydubai: "Uno de los pilotos apuñaló al otro. Al parecer, intentó estrellar el avión con sus ocupantes"

en.title: Israel investigates Flydubai flight incident as terrorist attack: "One of the pilots stabbed the other. Apparently he tried to crash the plane with its occupants"
en.summary: Israel is investigating a Flydubai flight incident as a terrorist attack after one pilot stabbed another. The injured Indian pilot is hospitalized in stable condition in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Rusia amenaza por carta a la OTAN con usar "armas nucleares" si los aliados intentan aislar Kaliningrado

en.title: Russia threatens NATO with nuclear weapons if allies attempt to isolate Kaliningrado
en.summary: Russia warned NATO in a diplomatic note against attempting to isolate Kaliningrado, prompting NATO to condemn the nuclear rhetoric as irresponsible and call for calm.

stories.title: Cristiano abandona la concentración de Portugal tras su enfrentamiento con el seleccionador

en.title: Cristiano leaves Portugal team camp after confrontation with coach
en.summary: The veteran forward, already frustrated about not playing against Norway, left the national team concentration after learning coach Jorge Jesus would also exclude him from the Denmark match.

stories.title: Cristiano abandona la concentración de Portugal molesto con el seleccionador: " A su debido tiempo contaré la verdad"

en.title: Cristiano leaves Portugal team camp upset with coach: "I will tell the truth in due time"
en.summary: Cristiano departed the national team concentration after a dispute with coach Jorge Jesus, following a federation summit that failed to resolve tensions over his substitute status.

stories.title: Rusia amenaza con usar armas nucleares contra los países de la OTAN en plena escalada de tensión en el Báltico

en.title: Russia threatens to use nuclear weapons against NATO countries amid escalating Baltic tensions
en.summary: Russia warned NATO in a diplomatic note against isolating Kaliningrado, while NATO accused Moscow of employing irresponsible nuclear rhetoric in the context of rising Baltic tensions.

stories.title: Terremoto en Portugal: Cristiano Ronaldo deja la concentración de la selección

en.title: Earthquake in Portugal: Cristiano Ronaldo leaves national team concentration
en.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo departed the Portuguese national team's training camp amid a dispute with coach Jorge Jesús over playing time, stating he would reveal details later.

stories.title: Rusia amenaza a la OTAN con su arsenal nuclear si aísla Kaliningrado

en.title: Russia threatens NATO with nuclear arsenal if Kaliningrad is isolated
en.summary: Moscow warned NATO that it would consider any attack or interference regarding Kaliningrad as a military act, referencing its nuclear capabilities.

stories.title: Execution of Christa Pike halted at the last minute by a Tennessee appeals court

en.title: Execution of Christa Pike halted at the last minute by a Tennessee appeals court
en.summary: A Tennessee appeals court stopped the execution of Christa Pike, who was 18 when she killed a fellow student in 1995. Her defense team has requested that her death sentence be commuted to life imprisonment.

stories.title: El piloto de un vuelo de Dubái con destino a Tel Aviv intentó estrellar su avión con 150 pasajeros

en.title: Pilot of Dubai flight bound for Tel Aviv attempted to crash plane with 150 passengers
en.summary: A crew member and passenger subdued an attacker who tried to stab the pilot and crash the aircraft, preventing a disaster.

stories.title: Lagarde sugiere que dejará el BCE "unos meses antes" de que expire su mandato

en.title: Lagarde suggests she will leave the ECB "a few months before" her mandate expires
en.summary: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde indicated she may step down before her mandate ends in October 2027, potentially triggering a succession process.

stories.title: Vueling recortará capacidad este invierno, pero se blinda en las rutas nacionales

en.title: Vueling will reduce capacity this winter, but strengthens domestic routes
en.summary: Vueling, IAG's subsidiary, plans 14.5 million seats between November and March while expanding domestic connections and maintaining substantial operations at its Barcelona hub with 10 million seats.

stories.title: Reino Unido encarga a ACS obras de limpieza nuclear por 1.750 millones

en.title: United Kingdom awards ACS nuclear cleanup contract worth 1.75 billion
en.summary: The United Kingdom contracted ACS for nuclear decommissioning work, with dismantling the Sellafield facility representing one of the nation's most critical projects.

stories.title: Nueva Pescanova vende la división de refrigerados de Francia al grupo ecuatoriano Omarsa

en.title: Nueva Pescanova sells French refrigerated division to Ecuadorian group Omarsa
en.summary: The Galician fishing company sold its French refrigerated products division to Ecuador-based Omarsa while retaining frozen goods operations in France as part of a strategic review.
